style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean home-disinfection tech visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cool mist-white #F1F6F5, charcoal text #2E3438, one luminous accent #2FBFB2 and one deep panel #1F7F79 reserved for the closing screen; cool tone; soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key, fill and soft contact shadows plus the lit tube as a practical light; modern geometric sans-serif type for headline and label typesetting; consistent rounded pill labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the product always standing upright at a stable scale and centered placement, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no turned-off tube.
style.presentationRules: the product always standing upright on its round base, full column visible, stable scale and centered placement, the lit tube as the single luminous element
